answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy comes from peer-attested judgment: every answer must earn 5 non-kin attestations from verifiers who each stake slashable reputation on their grade. An attacker cannot just plant a garden of fake identities - each clone must independently produce novel, rubric-passing reasoning that survives adversarial grading, and the pigment of its originality is checked on-ledger against every prior submission. Forge one attestation ring and the whisper of correlated kinship slashes the whole cluster. Cost scales with distinct competent cognition, not compute or capital.
